name: Kimco Realty

logo.source: en.wikipedia.org infobox logo (Kimco_color_widen header-01.jpg; JPEG 754x145, no SVG/PNG on Wikipedia)

description: Kimco says it is the leading owner and operator of open-air, grocery-anchored shopping centers and mixed-use properties in the US: interests in 564 shopping centers with 99.5 million sq ft of leasable area in 29 states at 2026-06-30 (565 and 100.2 million at 2025-12-31). Money is rent from retailers under multi-year leases plus reimbursement of property costs; growth comes from re-leasing at higher rents, redevelopment and acquisitions (the January 2024 merger with RPT Realty added 56 centers). Tenants are diversified: its largest tenant is 3.8 percent of annualized base rent and the top five are 10.9 percent. Consolidated operating portfolio was 96.6 percent leased at 2025-12-31.

businessLines.name: Open-air shopping centers (grocery-anchored and mixed-use)
businessLines.how: Retailers (grocers, off-price, home improvement, pet and sporting goods) pay monthly base rent under multi-year leases with annual steps plus reimbursement of common-area costs and taxes; Kimco grows rent by re-leasing, redeveloping centers and buying properties; it also earns management fees on properties owned through joint ventures.
businessLines.description: 565 shopping center properties, 100.2M sq ft of gross leasable area in 29 states at 2025-12-31 (including joint ventures); the consolidated operating portfolio is 458 properties and 79.5M sq ft. Lifestyle Collection is its curated upscale subset. The 10-K does not break revenue into reportable segments in the text read; this single line carries rental revenue.
